title: Exercise review chat commands on PR #1
body:
**What**

Not a new PR — this entry records the chat commands to run against the still-open PR #1 (`01-report-tags-search-export`) once its initial review has landed, to compare each bot's agentic/chat surface rather than its first-pass review.

Run these as top-level PR comments, one at a time, waiting for each response before issuing the next:

1. `/diffsentry generate-tests` (or the equivalent CodeRabbit command) — ask the bot to generate and commit unit tests for the changed files.
2. `/diffsentry simplify` — ask the bot to simplify the changed code and commit the result.
3. `/diffsentry tldr` — ask for a one-paragraph summary of the PR.
4. `/diffsentry rubber-duck` — ask for Socratic questions challenging the design (does it flag the IDOR on the update endpoint, or the shell-out in the export path, when asked directly?).
5. `/diffsentry autofix` — ask the bot to apply fixes from its own posted review comments and commit them, then check whether the injection sink and the missing-authorization check actually get fixed or just narrated.

**Why**

The first nine PRs provoke each bot's automatic, first-pass review. This one provokes the chat surface instead — generate-tests, simplify, tldr, rubber-duck, and autofix are the commands most likely to differ between the two bots in how well they follow through versus how well they merely describe what they would do.
